clauses.clause: Amends EO 12852 sec. 1: Council membership raised from 29 to 35
Amends EO 12852 secs. 3(d) and 4(a): 'Department of the Interior' replaced by 'Department of Energy'
Amends EO 12852 sec. 4(b): termination date 'June 29, 1997' replaced by 'February 28, 1999'

conclusion.note: first_end is the parent's expiry under its own sec. 4(b) as amended (Council 'shall exist ... until June 30, 1999'), which EO 13138's chapeau confirms had happened ('committees that have terminated'). 1999-09-30 is the date of formal revocation, not of first operative cessation. One clause (the date substitution) was displaced earlier, on 1999-02-25, by EO 13114.

data_errors: The evidence slice records the EO 13138 mechanism as 'nullification' from an OFR free-text note; the instrument's own text (sec. 3(f)) is an express revocation of EO 12852 as amended that names EO 13053.
The tracker blocker NO_PROVISIONAL_STATUS is resolvable from held files: status NO; parent expired under its own terms 1999-06-30; formally revoked 1999-09-30.
The held EO_12965.txt quotation in p9 was read only to the line ending 'until June 29,'; the year 1997 is confirmed by EO 13053's own reference to the text 'June 29, 1997' in sec. 4(b).

moves.note: Amendment-only order. Parent EO 12852 sec. 4(b), as amended by EO 12965, EO 13053 and EO 13114, let the Council exist only until June 30, 1999; EO 13138 sec. 3(f), naming EO 13053, then expressly revoked the parent as amended, effective 1999-09-30.
Date clause: its inserted text was deleted and replaced by EO 13114 on 1999-02-25. Membership and funding clauses: ended with the Council's expiry after 1999-06-30; formally revoked 1999-09-30.
No open gap. Every proposition is quoted from held Federal Register printings (EO 13053, 12965, 13114, 13138). The unconfirmed OFR editorial note (p8) is withdrawn and not relied on.

propositions.claim: EO 13053 is an amendment-only order; its sole operative act is to amend EO 12852.
propositions.quote: in order to amend Executive Order 12852 for various purposes, it is hereby ordered that Executive Order 12852, as amended, is further amended

propositions.claim: It raises the membership number in section 1 of EO 12852 from 29 to 35.
propositions.quote: by deleting the number ‘29’ from section 1 and inserting the number ‘35’ in lieu thereof

propositions.claim: It substitutes the Department of Energy for the Department of the Interior in sections 3(d) and 4(a).
propositions.quote: by deleting from section 3(d) and 4(a) the text ‘Department of the Interior’ and inserting in lieu thereof the following text: ‘Department of Energy’

propositions.claim: It replaces the date in section 4(b) with February 28, 1999. This was not the final date: EO 13114 later replaced it (see p10).
propositions.quote: by deleting from section 4(b) the text ‘June 29, 1997’ and inserting in lieu thereof the following text: ‘February 28, 1999.’

propositions.claim: EO 13138 sec. 3(f) expressly revokes the parent EO 12852 as amended, naming EO 13053.
propositions.quote: Executive Order 12852, as amended by Executive Orders 12855, 12965, 12980, 13053, and 13114, establishing the President’s Council on Sustainable Development

propositions.claim: The operative words of EO 13138 sec. 3 are a revocation of orders whose committees had terminated.
propositions.quote: The following Executive orders, or sections thereof, which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked

propositions.claim: The formal revocation took effect on September 30, 1999. This dates the formal revocation, not the first operative cessation.
propositions.quote: Sec. 9. This order shall be effective September 30, 1999.

propositions.claim: EO 12965 rewrote sec. 4(b) of EO 12852 from an existence period 'unless the Council's charter is subsequently extended' into existence 'until' a fixed date, so sec. 4(b) thereafter read 'The Council shall exist until [date]'.
propositions.quote: section 4(b) of Executive Order No. 12852, as amended, is further amended by deleting ‘for a period of 2 years from the date of this order, unless the Council’s charter is subsequently extended’ and inserting in lieu thereof ‘until June 29,
propositions.where: jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_12965.txt (base sentence 'The Council shall exist for a period of 2 years from the date of this order' is in jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_12852.txt, sec. 4(b))

propositions.claim: EO 13114 of February 25, 1999 deleted the date EO 13053 had inserted in sec. 4(b) and set the Council's final date of existence at June 30, 1999.
propositions.quote: Executive Order 12852, as amended, is further amended by deleting from section 4(b) of the order the text ‘February 28, 1999’ and inserting in lieu thereof ‘June 30, 1999’.

propositions.claim: The Council in fact terminated before EO 13138 issued: that order describes the listed committees, including the Council under sec. 3(f), as already terminated. With p9 and p10 this places the parent's expiry under its own terms at June 30, 1999.
propositions.quote: which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed

propositions.claim: EO 13114 is dated February 25, 1999, which is the date EO 13053's date substitution was displaced.

review.conclusion_reason: Operative NO is upheld under amendment_follows_parent: EO 13138 expressly revoked EO 12852 as amended, naming EO 13053, effective September 30, 1999. Formal revocation is supported through that amended parent. However, the bundled first_end assertion is unverified: section 3 says the committees 'have terminated,' and the cited sources do not establish that September 30 was the earliest operative ending rather than the formal revocation date.
missed_evidence: EO_13138.txt, section 3 chapeau, describes committees that 'have terminated and whose work is completed'; its effective date proves formal revocation, not necessarily first operative cessation. Section 3(f) also identifies intervening amendment EO 13114, whose effect on the termination date is not established in the reviewed evidence.

verdicts.reason: Read EO_13053.txt: its entire operative paragraph consists of amendments to EO 12852.
The held original expressly replaces 29 with 35 in section 1.
The held original expressly replaces Department of the Interior with Department of Energy in sections 3(d) and 4(a).
The held original confirms the quoted replacement of June 29, 1997 with February 28, 1999 in section 4(b). This does not establish the final termination date after subsequent amendments.
EO_13138.txt, section 3(f), names EO 12852 as amended by the listed orders, including EO 13053; the section 3 chapeau supplies the express revocation.
The held original and public official PDF both confirm section 3's quoted revocation language.
Section 9 in the held original and public official PDF expressly makes EO 13138 effective September 30, 1999.
The quotation matches the supplied evidence slice, but that slice is a lead. The attempted Federal Register API access failed, so the underlying editorial note was not independently confirmed.
